title: Add premium product quick-view modal on subcategory product cards + update header/footer logo

requirements.text: On subcategory pages (route pattern `/products/$categorySlug/$subcategorySlug`), change the product card interaction so clicking any product card opens a centered modal (quick-view) instead of navigating to a new page, while keeping the existing routing structure intact.

quotes: When any product card is clicked on subcategory pages (example: /products/saddles/english-saddles): Instead of navigating to another page, open a centered modal popup.
Do not remove: Product cards Routing structure Category hierarchy Only enhance interaction and branding.

acceptanceCriteria: On `/products/:categorySlug/:subcategorySlug`, clicking a product card does not change the URL and does not navigate away.
A modal opens centered on top of the current page content.
All existing product cards remain visible/unchanged when the modal is closed.
No changes are made to the overall routing table in `frontend/src/App.tsx` beyond what is required for the modal behavior (i.e., routes remain present and functional).

requirements.text: Implement the modal backdrop and open/close behavior: apply a semi-transparent dark overlay with `backdrop-filter: blur(6px)`, disable background scroll while open, and support closing via (1) a close button in the top-right, (2) clicking outside the modal, and (3) pressing the ESC key.

quotes: Background page should: Blur (backdrop blur effect) Darken slightly with semi-transparent overlay
Apply: backdrop-filter: blur(6px) Semi-transparent dark overlay Disable background scroll This is mandatory for premium feel.

acceptanceCriteria: When the modal is open, the page behind it is visibly blurred and darkened by an overlay.
When the modal is open, the document/body does not scroll (scroll is restored when the modal closes).
Clicking the overlay (outside the modal panel) closes the modal.
Pressing ESC closes the modal.
A visible close (X) control exists in the modal’s top-right and closes the modal.

requirements.text: Match the requested premium modal layout and responsive behavior: desktop/tablet shows a two-column layout with a large product image on the left and content on the right; mobile stacks with the image on top and content below. Content must include: product title (large serif), a 3–5 line description, a bullet feature list, and a “Send Inquiry” button.

quotes: Layout: Left side: Large product image Right side: Product title (large serif font) Full product description (3–5 lines) Bullet features list “Send Inquiry” button
Responsive behavior: On mobile: Image on top Content below

acceptanceCriteria: On >= md breakpoints, the modal presents image-left / content-right.
On small screens, the modal stacks content vertically with the image above the text content.
The modal shows: title (serif, prominent), a multi-line description, a bulleted list of features, and a “Send Inquiry” CTA button.
The modal image uses a non-stretched `object-fit` style (e.g., contain/cover as appropriate) and maintains aspect ratio.

requirements.text: Apply the exact modal styling and animation: modal background `#141F33`, subtle 1px gold border, soft glow shadow, and open/close animation using a subtle fade + scale (duration 0.3s ease; scale 0.95→1 and opacity 0→1 on open; reverse on close). The “Send Inquiry” button must use gold `#C8A24D` with dark navy text and hover effects (slight lift + slight darkening).

quotes: Button: Gold background (#C8A24D) Dark navy text Hover: Slight lift Slight darkening
Animation: Duration 0.3s ease Scale from 0.95 → 1 Opacity 0 → 1 Keep interaction subtle and premium.

acceptanceCriteria: Modal panel background color is `#141F33`.
Modal panel has a 1px gold-toned border and a soft glow shadow (not harsh or overly large).
Modal open transition uses fade+scale and completes in ~0.3s with ease timing; closing animates smoothly as well.
The “Send Inquiry” button uses `#C8A24D` background with dark navy text, and on hover both lifts slightly and darkens slightly.

requirements.text: Wire the modal “Send Inquiry” button to navigate to the existing contact page route (`/contact`) and prefill the category in the same way the current subcategory page CTA does (keeping existing inquiry flow intact).

quotes: Keep existing content Do not remove: ... Routing structure ... Only enhance interaction and branding.

acceptanceCriteria: Clicking “Send Inquiry” in the modal navigates to `/contact`.
The navigation includes the same category prefill behavior currently used by the subcategory page’s “Send Inquiry” button.
No backend changes are required for this wiring.

requirements.text: Replace the current site logo in both header and footer with the uploaded image file `Screenshot_2026-02-15_at_3.36.48_AM-removebg-preview.png`, ensuring: high-resolution usage, the header logo renders at ~2× the current size while keeping the header height unchanged, aspect ratio is preserved (no stretching), the logo remains vertically centered, and spacing around the logo is maintained. Update the footer logo to match the new asset as well.

quotes: Replace current logo with the newly provided image file.
Maintain aspect ratio Ensure logo remains vertically centered No stretching

acceptanceCriteria: `frontend/src/components/SiteHeader.tsx` and `frontend/src/components/SiteFooter.tsx` both reference `Screenshot_2026-02-15_at_3.36.48_AM-removebg-preview.png` (served from a static public path).
Header container height remains `h-20` (or otherwise unchanged), and nav items remain vertically centered.
Header logo appears visually ~2× larger than before without causing header growth; image remains vertically centered and not stretched.
Footer logo is updated to the same new image asset and maintains clean spacing (no distortion).

constraints: Do not remove or restructure existing product cards, category hierarchy, or TanStack Router routing; only enhance interaction on subcategory pages by using a modal quick-view instead of navigation.
Do not edit files under `frontend/src/components/ui` or any other immutable paths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.
Backend must remain single-actor; no backend changes are required for this request.
Use English for any user-facing text.
nonGoals: Creating new product detail pages or changing existing URLs beyond preventing navigation on card click.
Adding new authentication methods or third-party integrations.
Changing the product taxonomy structure or removing any existing catalogue content.
